intro: You are at Tokat Museum, in Tokat province, founded in 1926. For years it was housed in the Seljuk Gök Medrese before moving to a new building, and here it gathers the finds of the Komana Pontica excavation.
history: Founded in 1926, the museum spent years in the Seljuk Gök Medrese before moving to a new building. At its core are the finds of Komana Pontica, one of the great temple cities of antiquity.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the finds from Komana and the Seljuk works, then the manuscripts and the ethnography section.
facts: Did you know? The temple at Komana Pontica had a staff of six thousand attached to it, and the city was governed in the name of a goddess. And before its new home, the museum was housed for years in the Seljuk Gök Medrese.
outro: This brings our journey through Tokat Museum to an end. Before you go, a small request: please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. Let these treasures stay bright for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
